observations.observation: Prior public status was confidential: Anthropic’s June 1 statement said it had submitted a draft S-1 confidentially, with any offering conditional on SEC review and market conditions. A Reuters report in August described a planned public prospectus unveiling after Labor Day, but attributed that timetable to The Information and sources familiar with the process.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: These sources establish a confidential filing and a reported timetable, not that Anthropic publicly released a prospectus by the September cutoff.

observations.observation: The earliest traceable report found on the $518B figure is Reuters’ September 28, 7:17 PM ET article, updated at 7:18 PM. It says Reuters had seen the prospectus and describes cloud, computing, and infrastructure obligations; this copy says they were planned in the coming year.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The underlying prospectus was not publicly reproduced in this source, and this report alone does not establish the exact timing or cash-flow schedule of the obligations.

observations.observation: A Reuters dispatch carried by Fidelity at 8:01 PM ET on September 28 describes the same $518B obligations as occurring in the coming years. This is same-evening wording variation in Reuters copies; it supports multi-year phrasing before cutoff but does not by itself document a formal correction.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: Both pages carry Reuters reporting, not independent confirmation; no formal correction note or public prospectus passage verifying the duration was located.

observations.observation: Reuters’ early report also gives material context: 2025 revenue was nearly $4.6B, the net loss was about $42B (including an approximately $34B financing-related accounting charge), operating loss exceeded $8B, and nearly one-quarter of revenue came from two customers; the report says many large customers were not bound by long-term contracts.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: These financial and customer-risk details are reported from the prospectus by Reuters, not independently verified here. The spending description does not identify memory suppliers, HBM/DRAM/NAND volumes, or Micron allocation.

gaps: No independently reported non-Reuters contemporaneous coverage before the cutoff was verified.

No public copy of the prospectus or SEC filing passage containing the $518B figure was located in this focused search; exact duration, contractual composition, payment timing, and supplier-level allocations remain unverified.
The same-evening Reuters copies differ between singular- and plural-year wording; without a dated correction notice or original document passage, a formal correction cannot be confirmed.
research_notes: Cutoff: 2026-09-29T01:11:31.653741Z (2026-09-28 21:11:31 EDT). The $518B figure is traceable by cutoff to Reuters reporting that it had seen a prospectus, not to a public primary prospectus located in this search. Anthropic’s prior official statement described a confidential draft S-1. Same-evening Reuters versions differ: an early copy says obligations in the coming year, while an 8:01 PM ET Reuters dispatch says coming years. That supports multi-year wording appearing before cutoff but does not establish a formal correction or the exact obligation schedule. The reported cloud, computing, and infrastructure obligations do not specify Micron purchases or memory-product allocation; that is a scope limitation, not a conclusion about Micron demand.
